name: task-count-max
title: An ECS service has reached its maximum task count
description: An ECS service has scaled to its configured maximum number of tasks and cannot automatically add more capacity.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm to identify the affected ECS service.
Check CPU, memory, request volume and recent scaling activity.
Determine whether the maximum task count should be temporarily increased or whether an application problem is causing the load.
This could lead to service degradation or unavailability if the load continues and no additional capacity is added.
Using breakglass to temporarily increase the maximum task count may be necessary to restore service capacity while addressing the underlying issue.
